title: Breakpoint Centre
purpose: Acquire, stage, inspect and activate versioned breakpoint sources while preserving edition and file provenance.
boundaryBody: Imported workbooks are staged as versioned sets. Local custom rows are saved inactive and cannot affect interpretation until reviewed and activated through the governed workflow. Re-reading a source replaces its own earlier staging only while that staging has never been activated. Existing result provenance is never rewritten.

sources.toolkitBody: Open the current official implementation resources, then download the supported public workbook through the secure service.
sources.workbookBody: Upload .xlsx, .xlsb or .xls. A normalized “Breakpoints” sheet can include guideline, edition, method, organism, antibiotic, R/I/S thresholds, unit and comments.
sources.eucastBody: Published free of charge and redistributable with attribution, so this is the one table AMRIT can fetch for you. The download is staged for review, never activated automatically.
sources.eucastInstalled: Installed: v{{edition}}, {{count}} rows. Run the update when EUCAST publishes a new edition.
sources.eucastNotInstalled: No EUCAST table installed yet. The update fetches the current edition; if this machine has no network, the table bundled with this build is used instead.

help.licensing: Paid standards are never redistributed. Official links open CLSI access pages; public workbooks are downloaded from allowlisted CLSI hosts and hashed locally.
help.step1: Acquire or upload a source, or create an inactive custom row.
help.step2: Parse imported sources into a staged versioned set.
help.step3: Review row count, edition, warnings, code matches and SHA-256.
help.step4: Activate only a ready set with zero unmatched codes and explicit confirmation.
help.outro: Inactive custom rows remain editable in Master Studio but do not affect interpretation. QC ranges, expected-resistance definitions and expert rules are managed separately.
